---
title: Vendor Stories
description: Create and manage the story circles vendors tap through in the vendor app — image, video and text pages with optional in-app buttons.
---

## Overview

**Sidebar:** Vendors → Comms → **Stories** (`/vendors/stories`)

Stories are the Instagram-style circles shown in the vendor app. Each story has a cover and one or more pages (image, video or text) that vendors tap through. Use them for quick how-tos, feature launches and process updates.

## What the screen shows

A grid of story cards. Each card shows:

| Element | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Cover & name | Story cover image and story name. |
| Pages | Number of pages, with icons for the page types (image / video / text) and a link icon when a page has an in-app button. |
| Status | **Active** badge and an on/off switch (visible to vendors or hidden). |
| Likes | Count — click to **see who liked it**. |
| Comments | Count — click to **read the comments**. |
| Viewers | Click to **see who watched it**. |

## Filters & search

- **Search stories by name**.

## Actions

- **Add Story** (top right) — opens the Add Story dialog.
- **Click a card** — opens **Edit Story** (same fields), with **Save changes**, **Cancel** and **Delete story**.
- **Status switch** on a card — shows or hides the story for vendors.

### Add / Edit Story form

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **Cover** | Upload an image, max 10 MB. |
| **Story name** | e.g. "New pickup flow". |
| **Status** | "Visible to vendors" switch. |
| **Pages** | Click **Add page** to add more. Pages can be reordered with the drag handle. |

Each page has:

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **Type** | **Image**, **Video** or **Text**. |
| **Media** | Upload, max 10 MB (image/video pages). |
| **Caption** | Optional caption over the media. |
| **In-app route** | Optional route the page button opens, e.g. `/orders`. |
| **Button text** | Label for that button, e.g. "View orders". |

<Callout kind="tip">
Keep stories short (a few pages) and add an in-app route on the last page so vendors can jump straight to the screen you are explaining.
</Callout>
